title: 第781章 缓缓推动第780章 无人可以抵挡
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
，，！
与此同时，周天星斗大阵凝聚出的这道身影，抓着手中的黄金长枪，向前方刺出。
这一举动有些恐怖，只是缓缓推动了一寸而已，便让此处金光无量，闪耀出最强的光芒。
与此同时，周天星斗大阵爆发出绚烂的光芒，一种又一种古老的神通法术，在她手中施展了出来。
数之不尽的规则在围绕她盘旋。
巨大的锁链从苍天之上垂落下来，将虚空都缠绕封锁。
周天星斗大阵凝聚出的这道身影，怒吼咆哮，整个人陷入了一种类似于狂化的状态，在此处展开了最为凌厉的反攻。
他左手抓着那面古老的盾牌，右手握着那杆璀璨的黄金长枪。
一举一动，一呼一吸之间，神威盖世。
无匹的波动向四方蔓延，整个苍天都在为他臣服。
这一切实在太过可怕了，根本无法用言语来形容其中的恐怖。
「什么轮回？自从上古时代我就已经诞生了，俯瞰万古岁月，早就见惯了生死，世间之上哪里有什么轮回一说，就算是传说中的准圣死掉了，也只能化作一捧尘土。
」「谁敢在我面前妄谈轮回？就算是凤凰的不死涅盘，也不过只是传言而已，是空有其名。
」「真正的强者，从来不相信所谓的轮回，只相信这一世。
」周天星斗大阵凝聚出的这道身影大喝着，声音滚滚，如同雷霆一般向四方蔓延，震撼九天十地。
远方，周天星斗大阵凝聚出的第二道身影，听到这些话之后也是神色漠然，语气冷静。
他在这里点了点头，缓缓开口附和。
「说得没错，这个世界之上根本就没有轮回的人，更没有轮回的事。
」「超脱生死、自定规则，这种力量哪怕是传说中的三千神魔都做不到，就算是开天辟地的那一位大神死了，也就只是死了，只不过威名依旧存在而已，想要复活与轮回是绝对不可能的事情。
」周天星斗大阵凝聚出的那两道身影，全都在此处否定了传说中的轮回。

「这一切全都是因为那一滴血在此处作怪吗？」远处的方向有人在这里问道。
「幕后黑手的那一滴血究竟是什么？实在太强大了吧。
」「只不过是幕后黑手的一滴血而已，居然就需要周天星斗大阵来压制。
」「这未免有些恐怖得过头了吧。
」远方的战场之上，有人在此处小声说道，因为这一切实在有些可怕。
如果真的如同他所预料的这般，那幕后黑手究竟强到了什么级别？「幕后黑手很强，这一滴血也毫无疑问毋庸置疑地拥有着强大的力量，但这并不代表幕后黑手就是无敌的。
」就在此时，周天星斗大阵凝聚出的第二道身影这样开口说道。
他的眼光灿灿，双眸之中像是有无尽的星辰在环绕。
仔细看过去可以发现，一片又一片符文在何处流转，仿佛是辉煌的河流一样联接在一起，闪耀着至强的规则。
content_en:
,,!
At the same time, the figure condensed from Zhoutian's star formation grabbed the golden spear in his hand and stabbed forward.
This move was a bit scary, but it was only pushed slowly by an inch, and the golden light here shone with the strongest light.
At the same time, the Zhoutian Star Formation burst out with brilliant light, and one after another ancient magical powers were cast in her hands.
Countless rules swirled around her.
Huge chains hang down from the sky, wrapping and sealing the void.
The figure condensed in the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation roared and roared, and the whole person fell into a state similar to madness, and launched the most fierce counterattack here.
He held the ancient shield in his left hand and the brilliant golden spear in his right hand.
Every move, every breath, is filled with divine power.
Unparalleled fluctuations spread in all directions, and the entire sky surrendered to him.
All of this is so terrifying that words cannot describe the horror.
"What reincarnation? I have been born since ancient times. Overlooking the eternity of time, I have long been accustomed to life and death. There is no such thing as reincarnation in the world. Even if the legendary quasi-sage dies, it can only turn into a handful of dust.
"Who dares to talk about reincarnation in front of me? Even Phoenix's immortal nirvana is just a rumor, with no name."
"A truly strong person never believes in the so-called reincarnation, only believes in this life."
"The figure condensed from the Zhoutian Star Formation shouted loudly, and the sound rolled like thunder, spreading in all directions, shaking the nine heavens and ten places.
In the distance, the second figure condensed from the Zhoutian Starry Formation also had an indifferent expression and a calm tone after hearing these words.
He nodded here and slowly spoke in agreement.
"You're right, there are no reincarnated people in this world, let alone reincarnation.
"Beyond life and death and making your own rules, this kind of power cannot be achieved even by the legendary three thousand gods and demons. Even if the great god who created the world dies, it is just dead, but his reputation still exists. Resurrection and reincarnation are absolutely impossible.
"The two figures condensed out of the Zhoutian Star Formation all deny the legendary reincarnation here.
"Is all this because of that drop of blood?" Someone asked from a distance.
"What on earth is that drop of blood from the mastermind behind the scenes? It's really too powerful.
"It's just a drop of blood from the mastermind behind the scenes, and it actually needs the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation to suppress it."
"This is a bit too scary."
"On the battlefield in the distance, someone whispered here, because this is really scary.
If it was as he expected, how powerful was the mastermind behind the scenes? "The mastermind behind the scenes is very strong, and this drop of blood is undoubtedly powerful, but this does not mean that the mastermind behind the scenes is invincible.
"At this moment, the second figure condensed from the Zhoutian Xingdou Formation said this.
His eyes were bright, and his eyes seemed to be surrounded by endless stars.
If you look carefully, you can see where the runes are flowing one after another, connected together like a glorious river, shining with the most powerful rules.
